_: Editorial for cover-driver. Shared keys come from the family file.
_specs: Nothing about this product's construction is published. Unverifiable rows are marked, not guessed.
buyBody: A driver cover in signature white and gold. The driver is the most expensive thing in the bag and the one that spends the whole round unused, knocking against everything else. This is what stops it looking secondhand.

four.v: Ships in one to two days

details.headline: The most expensive club, doing the least work
paras: A driver gets used fourteen times a round and spends the other four hours being a crash barrier for the irons. It is also the club you paid the most for.
Against what the driver cost, the cover is not a difficult sum.

details.headline: Drivers
paras: Cut for a standard 460cc driver head. If you need one for a fairway wood or a hybrid, we do not make that yet.

_price: 2026-08-19: this page said 'Thirty dollars' TWICE about a cover that costs $40. Spelling a price out in words dodges the no-typed-price rule and then goes stale silently, which is exactly what happened: nobody re-reads prose when a price moves. The argument works without the number.
_cheap: Caught in the same pass that introduced it, 2026-08-19: the replacement line read 'this is the cheap insurance'. Spec-to-Benefit bans the word outright, and 26d had already removed it from THIS page in July. Two minutes old and it was the same violation.
